description: Search 141,187+ live, scam-filtered remote jobs (updated hourly). Natural-language queries OK (hybrid semantic search). Returns title, company, location, salary when disclosed, posted date, an employer apply_url, and a canonical detail_url to link back to.

country.description: ISO-2 country code the job must accept applicants from, e.g. "US", "HK", "DE"

has_salary.description: true = only jobs that disclose salary

posted_within_days.description: Only jobs posted in the last N days

query.description: Keywords or a natural-language description, e.g. "senior react engineer"

name: search_jobs
